## Multiple institutions disclose Microsoft positions in routine filings

Routine flow; no thesis implication for MSFT beyond continued broad institutional interest across a range of position sizes.

- Alamar Capital Management, Blacksheep Fund Management, and Fairbanks Capital Management each disclosed Microsoft (MSFT) positions.
- MSFT is a second-largest holding at Blacksheep and a fifth-largest holding at Fairbanks, per the disclosures.
- Alamar initiated a position of approximately $591,000.
- All disclosures are routine; no fundamental or business signal.
